questions.text: Which is a homogeneous mixture?
A mixture whose components can be distinguished from each other is called:
The molecular formula of water is ______.
The molecular formula of ozone is ______.
The molecular formula of carbon dioxide is ______.
Give a reason: Seawater is a homogeneous mixture.
questions.answer: Because its components are uniformly distributed and cannot be distinguished from each other.

questions.text: Give a reason: Sand can be separated from water by filtration.
questions.answer: Because sand is an insoluble solid in water and can be retained by the filter.

questions.text: Give a reason: Salt can be separated from water by evaporation.
questions.answer: Because water evaporates while dissolved salt remains.

questions.text: Compare homogeneous and heterogeneous mixtures.
questions.answer: Homogeneous mixture: components are uniformly distributed and cannot be distinguished. Heterogeneous mixture: components are non-uniform and can be distinguished.

questions.text: Viscosity is a physical property that expresses a liquid's resistance to ______.
Density is a physical property of matter.
Rusting of iron is a physical change.
Which is NOT a physical property?
Aerogel is characterized by:
choices: Low density and good thermal insulation
questions.answer: Low density and good thermal insulation

questions.text: Silicon is classified as a:

questions.text: Compare water and honey in terms of viscosity.
questions.answer: Honey has higher viscosity than water.

questions.text: Which sequence can be used to separate sand and salt from a mixture with water?
Give a reason: Salt solutions are mixtures, not pure substances.
questions.answer: Because they consist of more than one substance physically mixed and their components can be separated by physical methods.
